name: UT nursing flu-vaccination support at the Expo Center
summary: UT Austin nursing students, supervised by faculty, supported a community flu-vaccination event at the Travis County Exposition Center on November 7, 2020.
descriptionParagraphs: The UT Austin School of Nursing invited nursing students to volunteer at a community flu-vaccination event at the Travis County Exposition Center on November 7, 2020. Students worked under faculty supervision, helping with vaccination and patient education.
This was a single-day event and is no longer accepting volunteers. The notice does not state shift lengths. To learn about current opportunities, contact the organizer directly.

name: VAMOS community COVID-19 outreach at Rundberg
summary: Volunteers supported the UT Austin nursing VAMOS program's recurring COVID-19 vaccination outreach, including at Austin First Spanish SDA Church, documented in 2021.
descriptionParagraphs: VAMOS, a UT Austin School of Nursing program, ran recurring Wednesday COVID-19 vaccination outreach with community volunteers in 2021. The program's outreach included Austin First Spanish SDA Church on West Rundberg Lane.

The source confirms volunteer participation in the program and outreach at the church; it does not say which volunteers or roles were assigned to that location. This archived program is no longer accepting volunteers through this listing, and its last operating date is not documented.
